stickers.name: Coffee to go
stickers.css: .st1{animation:st1k 2.2s ease-in-out 0s infinite;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 100%}@keyframes st1k{0%{transform:translateY(6px) scale(.8);opacity:0}30%{opacity:.9}100%{transform:translateY(-18px) scale(1.1);opacity:0}}.st2{animation:st2k 2.2s ease-in-out 0.7s infinite;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 100%}@keyframes st2k{0%{transform:translateY(6px) scale(.8);opacity:0}30%{opacity:.9}100%{transform:translateY(-18px) scale(1.1);opacity:0}}.st3{animation:st3k 2.2s ease-in-out 1.4s infinite;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 100%}@keyframes st3k{0%{transform:translateY(6px) scale(.8);opacity:0}30%{opacity:.9}100%{transform:translateY(-18px) scale(1.1);opacity:0}}.mv{animation:mvk 3s ease-in-out infinite}@keyframes mvk{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-8px)}}.gs{animation:gsk 3s ease-in-out infinite;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 50%}@keyframes gsk{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(.82)}}
